name: TC-446: the physical gift card is offered to every restaurant — gift cards on or not — and the admin catalog agrees
description: Ordering a run of cards IS how an owner says they want to sell gift cards; the switch that makes them loadable is flipped on our side when the run is fulfilled. So the product must be in the shop even while this tenant's gift cards are OFF, with its picture, price and lead time.
